subject: Placeholder environment block textures for the industrial, shaft, walkway, street, chase, lift shaft, driller and machine boss levels: furnace drum, pipe outlet, valve wheel, large riveted pipe, lamp strip, lift cage and platform edge, cable spool, rusty girder, bridge deck and pier, road barriers, tank trap, banner, floodlight, shutter door, conveyor, drill face, crawler tread, battery rack.
visual_approach: Programmer pixel art: hard edges, no antialiasing, rusty teal and steel machinery with 1 px highlight / shade bevels, rivets and dark seams; amber lamps and hazard stripes, red marker lamps; colours from the project's shared palette.

generation_settings.palette: 85 hex constants: the 41 of tools/blocks_placeholder.py followed by 44 in tools/blocks_themes/common.py, all from the project's shared palette (not in the repository)

creative_seed.note: No generator seed. The script uses random.Random with fixed seeds (per-call seeds in the helpers, 201-223 in this theme's tiles) for small details such as rust spots, grime streaks and puddle glints. Every rebuild is identical.

style_inheritance: follows blocks-placeholder.png (same tile size, bevel and seam rules, palette extended from its palette)

post_analysis.provenance: Post-generation subagent visual analysis; not part of the original generation prompt.
post_analysis.subject: A 7 x 3 sheet of 21 pixel-art industrial tiles: pipes, machines, lift parts, girders, bridge parts, road barriers, a banner, lamps, a shutter, a conveyor, a drill face, a tread and a battery rack.
post_analysis.composition: Seven columns, three rows, each tile a separate square with its own flat side-on view. Tiles abut with no gaps or labels. Several tiles have strong horizontal bands (pipes, barriers, decks); others are centred single objects (banner, floodlight, drill face, tank trap).
post_analysis.environment: Dark navy-grey backdrops with grit specks in most tiles. Backgrounds read as shaft, street or machine-room walls. Two tiles have a wet-looking dark street strip at the bottom (barriers, tank trap). Pipe-outlet has a rust wall; banner-red has a grey wall.
post_analysis.colors: Dark slate and near-black base. Rust orange and brown, amber and yellow glows, black and yellow hazard stripes, teal on two pipes, red and white on one barrier, a flat red banner with gold, olive green on the drill face and the pouring liquid, grey steel and lavender-grey concrete. Small red and cyan indicator dots.
post_analysis.materials: Rusty metal with speckled corrosion; riveted steel plates and bands; glowing amber glass and grilles; painted hazard stripes; pale concrete with chips; cloth banner; dark lattice and mesh. Surfaces are shaded in flat pixel steps with dark outlines.
post_analysis.lighting: Self-lit amber windows, lamps and slats are the main light sources. Dithered dots suggest glow around lamps. Shading on pipes and posts is mostly vertical gradients, lighter at the top or left. No cast shadows. Lighting is consistent in style across the sheet.
standout_features: Strong amber glow tiles: furnace window, lift windows, shutter slats, floodlight head, battery cells
Black and yellow hazard stripes on four tiles
Red and white diagonal barrier is the highest-contrast tile
Red banner with a gold winged emblem
Circular drill face with green speckled gaps
Green liquid pouring from the pipe mouth
important_details: Row 1 tile 1 (furnace-drum): horizontal teal pipe-like drum with rust bands, amber grille window on the right, hazard stripe along the bottom - recognisable as an industrial machine; reads more as a pipe with a window than a drum
Row 1 tile 2 (pipe-outlet): rust-brown riveted wall with a round dark pipe mouth and bolted ring, olive-green liquid with speckles pouring down, teal pipe stub at left - recognisable
Row 1 tile 3 (valve-wheel): rust handwheel drawn as an ellipse with spokes, stem, over a rust pipe at the bottom, grey speckled background - recognisable; no steam visible
Row 1 tile 4 (pipe-large-riveted): wide rust-orange pipe with two vertical riveted flange bands and speckles - recognisable
Row 1 tile 5 (lamp-strip-v): vertical grey rail with two amber lamp segments and dark gaps, dithered side marks - recognisable
Row 1 tile 6 (lift-cage): amber-lit barred window in a steel frame, roof beam with a cable above, hazard band and floor below - recognisable as a lift car
Row 1 tile 7 (lift-platform-edge): hazard-striped top band, riveted beam with amber and red lamps, zig-zag struts below - recognisable
Row 2 tile 1 (cable-spool): drum of fine rust-brown horizontal windings between grey end flanges in a steel frame, thin cable at top - recognisable
Row 2 tile 2 (girder-rust-v): two rust posts with large X bracing and a centre plate on a dark background - recognisable
Row 2 tile 3 (bridge-deck): grey concrete top, steel girder with posts, orange lamp strip, two small red lamps hanging below - recognisable
Row 2 tile 4 (bridge-pier): lavender-grey column with two riveted steel bands and a small red lamp at the left edge - recognisable; the lamp sits partly off the column
Row 2 tile 5 (jersey-barrier): two blocks with orange and dark diagonal stripes, small dark slots, grey base, wet street strip below - recognisable
Row 2 tile 6 (barrier-red-white): two pale blocks with bold red diagonal stripes and chips, street strip below - recognisable
Row 2 tile 7 (tank-trap): two crossed grey beams in an X above a horizontal beam, dark street below - ambiguous; reads as a crossed X on a bar rather than a three-beam hedgehog
Row 3 tile 1 (banner-red): red banner with swallowtail bottom and gold winged emblem hanging from a gold rod on a grey wall - recognisable
Row 3 tile 2 (floodlight): lamp head with six yellow panes (3 x 2) on a dark lattice mast, dithered glow around it - recognisable
Row 3 tile 3 (shutter-door): amber horizontal slats in two bays with grey posts, header and base - recognisable
Row 3 tile 4 (conveyor): top belt with four round rollers, amber rail with rivets, dark legs below - recognisable
Row 3 tile 5 (drill-face): concentric grey toothed rings with green dotted gaps and a pale green centre on an olive background - recognisable as a cutter face; fine ring detail is noisy
Row 3 tile 6 (tread): top and bottom link plates with two large grey road wheels and small rollers on a dark body - recognisable as a track
Row 3 tile 7 (server-rack): two rows of four amber cells in steel shelves with green cable lines and a cyan dot at the right edge - recognisable as a cell or battery rack
post_analysis.synopsis: A coherent pixel-art set of industrial tiles in one palette and one flat side-on style. Almost all tiles read as their names. The only weak reads are the tank trap and, slightly, the furnace drum and the missing steam on the valve wheel.

findings.impact: Low; still recognisable as crossed beams

defect_analysis.overall: No serious defect seen: no floating objects, broken structure, distortion or lighting conflicts. Only minor readability notes above.
